limits: Finite measured workloads, not a universal lifetime/production-traffic guarantee.
RPC tariff valuation, not actual paid transaction or wallet-balance comparison.
Gov singleton factory allocation is a separate persisted-object microbenchmark, not a full deployment cost. It is not silently added to public user lifecycle totals.
Launchpad manager counts include a seed deposit; deposit debt lifecycle uses exactly 1/100 deposits.
No combined candidate/aggregate protocol saving, no migration or production deployment.
publication_policy: All measured fields, including Pool/Gov regressions, are now published in Draft tracker PRs at the user request. Publication is not a recommendation to deploy.
